scope: LONGHORN-49 full-copy CSI clone qualification only; not linked/nested clones or complete acceptance
conclusions: Full-copy creates independent copies; linked-clone shares source blocks through SPDK lvol copy-on-write. Their dependency, placement and cleanup conditions differ.

Pinned CSI CreateVolume compares requested clone size with source size before creating either V1 or V2 clones. Require exact UID-bound ProvisioningFailed size mismatch, then qualify equal-sized V2 full-copy through the product-deployed class.

Clone copy completion is distinct from healthy completion. Reject copy-completed-awaiting-healthy as final acceptance; require Volume cloneStatus.completed, three healthy RW replicas and original raw-disk placement.

A linked clone can be marked completed after some error/rebuild retry boundaries while degraded. The full-copy qualifier must independently require all three healthy replicas; it cannot reuse a state word as redundancy proof.

Reuse the existing CSI clone routine for size refusal, initial bytes and clone-to-source write isolation. A V2 wrapper verifies native mode/source/replica independence and the reverse direction with a separate fsynced source file so original source data still has cross-node readback.

Product entry remains config.yml plus kubecli setup 09. Reenter product configuration before application PVC cloning; cleanup uses the existing exact business UID journal. No new image or mutation of installation prerequisites is required.
classification: test-gate reuse with V2 native identity and bidirectional data assertions; production clone configuration already exists
coverage_boundary: No source deletion/failure, nested/linked lifecycle, expansion, eviction/rebuild dependency, independent backup restoration, complete LONGHORN-49 or final delivery PASS.
